title: Earthworm Unit Study Pack (unknown creator)
dropperComment: Elementary and early middle grade. love the art and activities. inclusion of multiple disciplines such as art, reading comprehension, report, math - lovely example of a unit study that can be adapted to multiple age levels and grades

difficulty.multiAgeNotes: Explicitly designed for mixed ages 4-12. Pages 1-23: science content + activities for elementary/middle. Pages 24-41: 'Morning Basket' early learning pages for Pre-K/K. Pages 42-44: outdoor observation activity for all ages.

components.name: Guide & Contents (p1-2)
components.description: Overview of 40-page pack with contents list and printing instructions.

components.name: Taxonomy Cards (p3-4)
components.description: Taxonomic classification of earthworm (Kingdom → Species) — filled version + blank fill-in-the-blank version.

components.name: Anatomy Poster + Activity (p5-6)
components.description: Labeled worm anatomy (clitellum, segments, mouth, anus) + blank version for student labeling.

components.name: Lifecycle Poster + Cut-and-Paste (p7-8)
components.description: Circular lifecycle diagram (mating → egg → embryo → hatchling → adult) + cut-out images to arrange in correct order on blank template.

components.name: Reading Comprehension (p9-10)
components.description: Short story about 'Wiggly the worm' + drawing challenge ('draw Wiggly making tunnels').

components.name: Acrostic Poem (p11)
components.description: WORMS acrostic poem template with drawing space.

components.name: Information Sheets + Question Worksheets (p12-23)
components.description: 5 detailed info pages covering earthworm biology (lifespan, movement, breathing, reproduction, importance to gardens, lifecycle stages) each followed by reflection question worksheets. Blank question worksheet included for parent customization.

components.name: Morning Basket Pages (p24-41)
components.description: 18 pages of Pre-K/K activities: letter W tracing (upper + lower), letter recognition (circle the W), loose parts letter formation, garden sorting (cut-and-paste), maze, jigsaw puzzles (3 sets), size sorting cards, uppercase/lowercase letter matching with garden baskets, counting clip cards (how many worms? — 8 cards across 4 pages).

components.name: Lifecycle Flashcards (p42)
components.description: Cut-out lifecycle stage images for flashcards or memory match game.

components.name: Outdoor Observation Activity (p43-44)
components.description: Guided outdoor activity: dig in garden, find worms, measure with ruler. Observation report template: date, size, description, comparison ('was it bigger than the one before?').

notes: 44 pages. Different creator than Stephanie Hathaway (no watercolor style — more digital/graphic illustration). Carolyng explicitly called out: art, reading comprehension, report, math, multiple disciplines, adaptable to multiple ages. The 'Morning Basket' section (18 pages!) is distinctive — it's a dedicated block of Pre-K activities themed to the same topic, so youngest children participate in the unit study alongside older siblings. The outdoor observation report is the first field-study activity we've seen — takes learning outside with measurement tools. The taxonomy card (Kingdom through Species) is surprisingly advanced content presented in a simple fill-in format. The blank question worksheet for parent customization is a UX insight — parents want to write their own questions tailored to their child.
